name: 飞行头盔
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production equipment icon for an anime aircraft action RPG, isolated RGBA sprite.
Input image 1 is the current special-set helmet, the edit target and the established illustration/palette reference.
Primary request: substantially redesign this helmet so the premium Saint Ring set has a visibly different silhouette and engineering from ordinary equipment. Keep it a wearable enclosed futuristic pilot helmet, NOT a whole character. Preserve the existing polished anime mechanical illustration finish, white ceramic armor, champagne gold structure, graphite inner joints and vivid emerald/teal energy accents.
Replace the smooth motorcycle-like dome and simple fins with a strong angular elite flight-mecha silhouette: raised split crown/brow plates, a compact high protective jaw, separated blade-like temple armor, and a small articulated segmented halo structure attached closely behind the crown and sides. The ring is machined plated technology, with gaps and emerald energy seams, not a flat decorative magic circle. Give the visor a sharp emerald horizontal V profile. The main visual hierarchy is broad ivory armor, dimensional gold ribs, one bright emerald visor/core. Three or four large readable shapes, restrained seams, no tiny busy engraving.
Three-quarter front view matching the source direction. One helmet only, entire item visible, centered, consistent upper-left soft studio light, clean dark contour, dimensional cel-shaded painted highlights, no photoreal material noise. At 64 pixels this must be more distinctive than a gold repaint of the ordinary helmet.
Background must be truly transparent. Keep generous 12% transparent margin around all protrusions. No person, head, mannequin, labels, text, UI border, stars, rarity frame, pedestal, watermark, floating sparkles, scenery or cast shadow outside the item. Preserve real transparent alpha.
